scripts.build: pnpm build:server && pnpm web:build && pnpm marketing:build
scripts.db:up: docker rm -f freshskin-pg >/dev/null 2>&1; docker run -d --name freshskin-pg -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=postgres -e POSTGRES_DB=freshskin -p 55432:5432 postgres:16
scripts.db:reset: pnpm db:up && sleep 3 && DATABASE_URL=postgres://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:55432/freshskin pnpm db:migrate && DATABASE_URL=postgres://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:55432/freshskin pnpm db:seed
scripts.lint:tokens: grep -rn '#[0-9a-fA-F]\{3,8\}' apps/web/src apps/marketing/src packages/ui --include='*.css' --include='*.tsx' --include='*.ts' 2>/dev/null | grep -v 'packages/ui/tokens.css' | grep -v '\.test\.' && { echo 'HEX OUTSIDE TOKENS — see AGENTS.md'; exit 1; } || echo 'tokens clean'
scripts.verify: pnpm lint:tokens && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm test
